design: GovernedMemoryItem.from_mapping is the closed record of reports/contracts/governed-memory-item.schema.json: exact field set, no aliases/coercion, every allOf branch; set-like arrays are canonical sets so the digest is order-independent.
CAPABILITY_MATRIX declares all 56 kind/scope pairs; WORKING only RUN/TASK and TEAM_SHARED only TEAM/PROJECT (taxonomy minimum authority treatment); other pairs UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY.

MemoryAdmissionService.admit follows the normative order of the change-control §8: GCS rebuilt from the authenticated binding and re-digested, closed schema, capability, binding of the item to the GCS, idempotency, content class/digest/prohibited payloads, boundary-clock temporal and retention rules, contiguous immutable lineage, source/evidence/provenance resolution under the GCS, conservative marking join, taint, scope Authority, instruction eligibility, live policy; persistence is the last step, one atomic append of metadata+content ref+lifecycle event+audit.
Reason codes are only the closed OpenAPI Problem enum; detail_code refines without widening it; Problem bodies validate against the OpenAPI schema and never echo payload content.

environment.backend_under_test: none for the component itself: memory/model.py is backend-free by OCOR_LANGUAGE_POLICY row 8 (no backend client outside adapters/). Qualifying persistence cases use the real hash-chained JSONL journal on the local filesystem with real separate interpreter processes (cross-run read-back, cross-process append race under flock, tamper/torn-write/reorder detection).
environment.regression_stack: ocor-bootstrap (11 services READY via verify_external_services.py --execute --typed) after reset_test_environment.py --execute and bootstrap_development_environment.py --execute; OCOR_LIVE_POSTGRES_DSN set to the real bootstrap PostgreSQL

inputs_tree_definition: git rev-parse <commit>:inputs (tree della directory inputs/ immutabile)
normative_interpretations: Capability matrix content (which pairs are unsupported) is not enumerated by ADD/LLD: chosen fail-closed from the change-control §5 minimum authority treatment; changing it requires only editing CAPABILITY_MATRIX.
Content-class registry (urn:ocor:memory-content:<class>:<version>) and payload markers are boundary configuration; prohibited classes from ADD v1.3 Part II §2.4 are always refused.

Instruction eligibility admitted only for PROCEDURAL kind with a separate approval by a principal other than the owner, bound to the exact item and content digest (LLD §2.8.5); model-generated content never eligible at admission.
Admission enters the lifecycle at PROPOSED/ACTIVE/QUARANTINED only; later statuses are lifecycle transitions (OCOR-DEV-0055).
created_at must lie within +/-30 s of the trusted boundary clock; expiry/validity/evidence retention evaluated on the boundary clock, never on caller values.
raw_output_format: JSONL: una riga per comando con label, command, exit_code, sha256 del byte stream originale e output UTF-8 originale integrale

reproducible_check.scope: inputs (file e tree) a commit e HEAD, diff dopo il commit limitato alle evidenze, hash del raw log e di ogni voce JSONL, hash del manifest, conteggi dei casi dalla JUnit nel raw log, conteggi della suite completa

requirement_coverage_note: Backlog requirement_ids include NFR-025 (Function sandbox quotas) and NFR-075 (benchmark workload manifest): this admission slice has no direct oracle for them and no PASS is claimed for them; they remain for the tasks that implement execution sandboxing/benchmarks.

requirement_results.command: closed GovernedMemoryItem: exact normative field set, every allOf branch positive+negative against the normative JSON Schema and the runtime, every required field, malformed values, aliases, canonical round trip
all 56 kind/scope pairs declared explicitly; every one of the 8 kinds and 7 scopes has a supported pair
every supported pair admitted: schema-valid persisted item, evidence/provenance refs, policy decision and correlation in the audit event, receipt valid against the OpenAPI MemoryReceipt
every unsupported pair fails with UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY and zero ledger appends
missing provenance/evidence/marking/taint, invalid kind/scope, envelope, lifecycle, kind semantics, digest, boundary-clock and reference-resolution failures rejected with zero appends
binding required; tenant/compartment/purpose/owner/policy/GCS digest must equal the authenticated eleven-field GCS
marking dominates the join of context and inputs; inputs above context and cross-tenant/compartment lineage denied
hidden reasoning, secrets, credentials, tokens and raw conversation refused; required taint per source kind; taint inherited along lineage
instruction eligibility only for PROCEDURAL memory with a separate, exact, current approval by another principal; model-generated content never eligible
federation Authority required; policy deny/stale/outage and resolver outage fail closed with a policy-safe Problem
idempotent replay, digest conflict, overwrite refused before persistence, contiguous supersession lineage, thread race with one winner, ledger-level gap/slot/key guards

versions persist across separate interpreter processes with exact replay; rejected candidates leave the journal byte-identical; process race one winner; tamper, torn write, removal and reorder detected fail closed

residual_risks: Policy/Authority and reference resolution are ports; this task exercises them with explicit fixture registries. Binding to the real OPA/Keycloak control plane (OCOR-DEV-0048) and to the real metadata/content stores (OCOR-DEV-0051) is out of this task's expected_file_areas.
Quota and payload-size backpressure (ADD v1.3 Part II §2.13) are not enforced here; OCOR-DEV-0059 owns memory quotas.
Projection scheduling (full-text/vector) is not performed; OCOR-DEV-0051/0052/0053 own projections.
Payload secret detection is pattern-based and cannot be complete; the closed content-class registry is the primary control.
